abilities.name: Rad Tongue
abilities.description: Taste water or food and sense whether it is too irradiated to eat.
abilities.cost: A metallic taste for an hour; you still take a little poison

growth.grows: how faint a contamination you catch

abilities.name: Junk Gun Fix
abilities.description: Rebuild a broken firearm from scrap so it can fire a handful of shots.
abilities.cost: It jams for good after those shots

growth.grows: how many shots and how good the gun

abilities.name: Raider Read
abilities.description: Read a raider's gear and paint and know which gang they ride with and how close the rest are.
abilities.cost: Only gangs whose sign you have seen before

abilities.name: Fuel Sniff
abilities.description: Smell fuel in a ruined vehicle and know whether there is enough left to drain.

growth.grows: how little fuel you can sense

abilities.name: Mutant Hide
abilities.description: When you are hit, you can let a patch of toughened skin take the blow like leather.
abilities.cost: The patch itches and spreads a little each time

growth.grows: how hard a blow and how large the patch

abilities.name: Dust Squall Walker
abilities.description: When a dust storm hits, you can keep your bearings and walk straight toward any place you have seen.
abilities.cost: Eyes and lungs burn for a day

abilities.name: Bunker Code Hunch
abilities.description: Hold a sealed bunker keypad and sense which numbers have been pressed most often.
abilities.cost: Wrong guesses can lock the door for good

abilities.name: Caravan Talk
abilities.description: Speak caravan cant and traders treat you as one of their own, giving you fair prices for one deal.
abilities.cost: Cheat them once and every caravan hears

growth.grows: how many caravans know your name

abilities.name: Geiger Gut
abilities.description: You can sense hot zones in the ruins as a sick feeling in your stomach a block before you reach them.
abilities.cost: Nausea every time you are near one

abilities.name: Scrap Armor
abilities.description: Strap scrap metal to yourself in ten minutes so one gunshot glances off before it falls apart.
abilities.cost: Heavy and loud; it falls apart after one hit

abilities.name: Long Thirst
abilities.description: You can go a full day in the heat on a single cup of water without collapsing.
abilities.cost: The next day you must drink twice as much

abilities.name: Dog Pack Call
abilities.description: You can whistle and wild dogs that have eaten from your hand will come and guard you for a night.
abilities.cost: You must feed them every time

growth.grows: how many dogs and how fierce
